classification.difficultyReason: Combine equal-chord isosceles-triangle reasoning with angles standing on the same arc.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Four vertices on a circle with five chords, matching single ticks on the two bottom chords, a complete 140-degree bottom angle crossed by the top–bottom chord, and x at the top. The centre O is offset from the top–bottom chord.
spec.mathematics: The equal bottom chords form an isosceles triangle with vertex angle 140 degrees. Each base angle is 20 degrees. The top angle and the lower-right base angle stand on the same chord.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x and the supplied 140-degree angle appear in the question diagram; the printed teacher answer is omitted.

answer.worked:
The two marked chords are equal, so the triangle with the bottom vertex is isosceles.
$$\begin{aligned}
\text{Base angle}&=\frac{180^\circ-140^\circ}{2}\\
&=20^\circ\\
x&=20^\circ
\end{aligned}$$
Angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.
